name: USD CoinVertible
oneLiner: USDCV is Societe Generale-FORGE's MiCA-regulated dollar stablecoin, backed by cash at BNY and Societe Generale; EEA holders have a direct 1:1 redemption right.
collateral: U.S. dollar cash deposits held 1:1 in segregated accounts at The Bank of New York Mellon SA/NV and Societe Generale; holder claims are protected from other issuer creditors under French law, and reserve composition is disclosed daily by SG-FORGE.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through SG-FORGE for EEA-resident holders after KYC/AML and sanctions checks; the issuer confirms receipt within five business days, and payment is due by the last business day of the month following the month controls are completed. Non-EEA holders have no direct issuer redemption right, and U.S. residents are excluded.

latestReport.reviewer: R2 family-consistency research 2026-10-21: dashboard Last update 21/10/2026 shows 14,176,206.00 USDCV in circulation against USD 11,000,000.00 at BNY (77.59%) and USD 3,176,206.00 at Societe Generale (22.41%), which sum to the outstanding amount. Aggregated across Ethereum, Solana and Canton per white paper C.2.
